statement: A failure bundle records, for each retained node-log window, its coverage of the failure window (first divergence to the end of the run) and the byte count it withheld, and a bundle whose coverage is partial is published as incomplete: the scenario verdict for it is non-measuring with the withheld bytes named, never a dominant reason derived from the retained tail; the LOG_TAIL_LINE_COUNT writer in test/distributed/harness/failure-bundle-artifact-foundation.js gains that coverage record or is replaced by retention bounded in bytes from the first divergence.

constraints.statement: When the analysis cannot be complete, the bundle fails the subject and states how much went unexamined; it never reports a verdict derived from the part it saw (runner-output-bound, 2026-09-18).
Retention is bounded in bytes, not lines, so a newline-free log cannot defeat the bound.

The uncommitted retainContainerLogLines and terminal-status-set changes on work/composed-05-comparison-readiness-20261103 are the starting material; they land through this quest or are superseded by it, never both.
This quest changes test/ and scripts/ only. A src/ change it uncovers is recorded and routed to its owner (R17).
